art.projection: upright sprite anchored over projected isometric map tiles
art.visual_design: Hooded medieval labourer with tunic, belt, simple tool; neutral cloth/leather

actions.description: Worker is standing idle, then settles into a long-idle arms-crossed pose.
phases: Relaxed idle, arms at sides, both feet planted.
Long-idle hold pose, arms crossed, both feet planted.

actions.description: Worker walks across the map with an alternating two-step gait.
phases: Walking gait with the front or near leg forward and the rear or far leg back.
Walking gait with the rear or far leg forward and the front or near leg back.

actions.description: Worker chops an adjacent tree or wood resource with an axe.
phases: Axe at the bottom or contact part of the chop, axe head low and forward.
Axe raised high at the top of the swing.

actions.description: Worker mines an adjacent gold deposit with a pickaxe.
phases: Pickaxe at the bottom or contact part of the mining swing, pick head low and forward.
Pickaxe raised high at the top of the swing.

actions.description: Worker gathers berries from an adjacent berry resource.
phases: One hand reaching out toward berries beside a basket.
Hand back in the basket with berries.

actions.description: Worker tends a farm on an adjacent tile with a farming hoe.
phases: Arms outstretched with the hoe extended away from the body.
Arms pulled in after the hoe stroke while still holding the same farming hoe.
actions.tool: long-handled farming hoe with a small flat rectangular blade, not an axe or pickaxe

actions.description: Worker gathers wheat with a sickle.
phases: Using a sickle to cut wheat.
Still holding the sickle while the free hand reaches for wheat.

actions.description: Worker kneels and hammers an adjacent construction site.
phases: Kneeling builder with hammer raised up.
Kneeling builder with hammer down.

actions.description: Worker carries wood back to a drop-off while walking.
phases: Carrying bundled logs while walking, front or near leg forward.
Carrying bundled logs while walking, rear or far leg forward.
actions.carry: bundled logs held securely in both arms

actions.description: Worker carries gold ore back to a drop-off while walking.
phases: Carrying stones and gold ore while walking, front or near leg forward.
Carrying stones and gold ore while walking, rear or far leg forward.
actions.carry: pile of grey stones and yellow gold ore held in both arms

actions.description: Worker carries a basket of berries back to a drop-off while walking.
phases: Carrying berries while walking, front or near leg forward.
Carrying berries while walking, rear or far leg forward.
actions.carry: basket of red berries held in both arms

actions.description: Worker carries wheat back to a drop-off while walking.
phases: Carrying wheat while walking, front or near leg forward.
Carrying wheat while walking, rear or far leg forward.
actions.carry: bundle of wheat held securely in both arms

actions.description: Worker gathers meat from an adjacent animal carcass with a knife.
phases: Holding a knife while actively cutting or reaching toward meat.
Still holding the knife while taking meat with the free hand.

actions.description: Worker carries meat back to a drop-off while walking.
phases: Carrying meat while walking, front or near leg forward.
Carrying meat while walking, rear or far leg forward.
actions.carry: large cut of meat held in both arms

actions.description: Worker attacks an adjacent target with a wooden club.
phases: Club at the top of the attack swing, held overhead but still inside the tile.
Club at the bottom or contact part of the attack swing, still fully inside the tile.

actions.description: Worker dies, then the body decays into skeleton remains.
phases: Dead villager body lying on the ground, not a skeleton.
Skeleton remains of the same villager in the same ground area, with small clothing and tool scraps.
